```plato

    //==
    // # PointSet vertex centroid
    //
    // The arithmetic mean of a shape's defining points, folded over the Points
    // array. This is the centroid of the VERTICES as equal point masses, NOT the
    // area/volume-weighted center of mass a ICentroid2D/3D implementor reports; the
    // two differ whenever the vertices are unevenly distributed. Offered on the
    // PointSet surface because it is well defined for any point set, including a
    // scatter with no interior. Precondition: at least one defining point.

    // The vertex centroid of the shape: the arithmetic mean of its defining points.
    VertexCentroid(self: IPointSet2D): Point2D
        => self.Points.AverageOfPoints;
```
